items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'O'Connor' in the context of listing people associated with the Nazarra family, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or interaction with O'Connor.

ctx.x: And, well, he got attached to them, and eventually the Nat Nazarra and Sons act, I think they broke up, you see. They went off on their own, see. They become millionaires or something, see, and one of them is -- there's about three of them still alive, you see.

John Barner, that's one of Nat Nazarra's sons. What's the fellow that plays Mannix, O'Connor, he's another one, John Ireland. That's big brother John. He's one. And then there's Cliff Nazarra and Nat Nazarra, Jr. They're all alive. They're still alive.
And then -- well, the only one that's passed already is Mr. Buck. And, of course, Nat Nazarra, Sr., he passed some years ago. He passed in 1959, I think.
